messages:
elaine_cs: FYI onboarding for FinFlow — they're seeing intermittent 401s and 429s during SDK handshake after ramping tests. Root msg: "token invalid" or "rate limit exceeded" in logs.
ivy_finflow: here's the paste from our dev logs, we only switched to the node sdk yesterday. 401s at ~12:34:22, 429s at 12:35:10. headers: `x-request-id: abc123`, `retry-after: 10` sometimes present, sometimes not.
sam_devx: what's the SDK version? also are you using an ephemeral key or a long-lived API key?
ivy_finflow: node-sdk v1.4.2, using a server-side key stored in env (not ephemeral).
raj_infra: can you paste the curl equivalent of the failing call? we want to see Authorization header and token scope.
ivy_finflow: curl below — we redacted token but kept headers
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"hello"}'
```
sam_devx: ok. two quick thoughts: 1) If multiple test clients are using the same token concurrently it can hit our burst-protection; add an exponential backoff with jitter; respect `Retry-After` when present. 2) check token scopes with `GET /v1/auth/introspect` (we can provide endpoint) — sometimes onboarding keys were created with limited scopes and return 401 on tool-calling paths.
ivy_finflow: backoff implemented now, still saw a 401 once after retry.
elaine_cs: I'll open a CS ticket and sync with acct manager — julia, can you flag renewal risk if this blocks prod ramp?
acct_manager_julia: flagged. also offering 1 week of free Dedicated throughput for their onboarding window if infra confirms rateback is server-side.
deploybot: Deploy 2026-03-17T12:40:00Z: rolled node-sdk v1.4.3 to staging (contains client-side rate limiter example)
sam_devx: raj — can you check server-side logs for x-request-id abc123 and tell us whether it's a token-scope failure vs rate limit?
raj_infra: checking... found several entries: 401 with reason `invalid_scope` for that request id; separate cluster showed `rate_backoff` events matching their IP fingerprint around 12:35.
sam_devx: that explains both. tell them to rotate to a key with proper scopes and reduce concurrency. Also we can add a provisioning exception — @acct_manager_julia can talk to them about temporary higher ingress.
ivy_finflow: thanks — we rotated to a full-scope key and throttled concurrency to 4 workers, tests look stable now. will keep watch.
elaine_cs: great — please share a few sample request ids if you see flakiness. follow-up: we'll schedule a 30m enablement call to review SDK best-practices (retry, concurrency, caching). :thumbsup:
ivy_finflow: sending a short follow-up note: `x-request-id: def456` from later test where everything passed.
sam_devx: noted. will add a short FAQ snippet to the onboarding doc about ephemeral vs long-lived keys and concurrency defaults.
acct_manager_julia: closing loop with FinFlow on credits and offer stands — ping me if any regressions.
elaine_cs: closing this thread — thanks everyone.
